description:
ROOT CAUSE confirmed by fz-go4.18.40 diagnosis (verdict (b): structural gap, NOT the .28.6 ReturnType nondeterminism).

World::demand_function_scope's global-module branch (world.rs ~2098) maps CodeState::Pending => None, contributing NO wait fact for a not-yet-indexed candidate home code. publish_function_source_job's not-yet-stashed branch (jobs/source.rs ~280) pushes FactKey::FunctionSourceStash(function) on top of demand_function_scope's result -- and FunctionSourceStash has NO producer arm in demand_fact_producer (drive.rs ~128/183, co-output-only by design, fz-go4.38). So whenever demand_function_scope returns empty because the global function's home code is still Pending, PublishFunctionSource waits SOLELY on the arm-less FunctionSourceStash: nothing independently demands CodeIndexed/CodeScoped on that code, the stashing scope job never runs, the fact never bumps, the wait is permanent. This is a latent deadlock-by-construction introduced by the fz-go4.38/.39 interaction (before .38, stash_function_source's unconditional push masked it).

CONTRAST: every other 'not ready yet' fallback in the file already names an arm-covered fact -- scope_code (source.rs) waits CodeIndexed, define_module waits CodeIndexed, the module-scoped branch of demand_function_scope waits ModuleDefined. Only the global Pending arm names nothing. This fix restores consistency-by-construction.

FIX (work-minimal, correct-by-construction): in the global branch, classify codes -- Indexed-and-can-publish => CodeScoped(code); still-Pending => CodeIndexed(code) (producer arm Job::IndexCode). Return the CodeScoped set if a home is already known (do NOT also wait on Pending others -- that would be over-demand); otherwise return the Pending CodeIndexed set (each is a candidate home to be resolved once indexed); otherwise empty (the genuinely terminal case -- every code enumerated+indexed, none the home -- where the FunctionSourceStash-only wait is legitimately correct for a dangling/deferred reference). Do NOT use the naive 'Pending => Some(CodeIndexed)' that always includes pending even after a home is found.

TDD: white-box unit test on demand_function_scope proving it NEVER returns empty while any candidate home code is still Pending (register a global function whose home code is Pending/un-indexed; assert result names CodeIndexed(home), an arm-covered fact -- not empty). This captures the invariant directly; the full end-to-end 00181 stall is build-schedule-elusive (fz-go4.18.40 could not force it locally and PROVED it cannot fire for FunctionId(0)/main under this harness's FIFO IndexCode-before-SeedRoot ordering), so the unit-level invariant is the sound TDD target.

SCOPE GUARD: this fix closes the structural dead end; it does NOT claim to fix 00181. The 3 #[ignore]'d tests (backend_program_surfaces_per_callable_boundary_association, enum_reduce_operator_refs_settle_through_kernel_specs, pull_only_guard_holds_for_enum_reduce_operator_ref) stay #[ignore]'d until 00181 is INDEPENDENTLY shown deterministic. Blast radius: global-module functions whose owning code arrives via a lazy/non-ignition path (ensure_runtime_module-registered runtime/builtin modules, per fz-go4.39) and is still Pending when their PublishFunctionSource first runs.

comments.text:
AUDIT (correctness lane) found a BLOCKER, VERIFIED by me against scheduler.rs:397. The first cut (d56a1fa8d) is necessary-but-INSUFFICIENT.

Root: scheduler waiter re-enqueue is AND-semantics -- enqueue_dependents (scheduler.rs:395-406) re-runs a waiter ONLY when waits.iter().all(satisfies). publish_function_source_job (jobs/source.rs:281) UNCONDITIONALLY appends the arm-less FunctionSourceStash to demand_function_scope's result. So in the pending case the wait is {CodeIndexed(pending), FunctionSourceStash}: when IndexCode bumps CodeIndexed, all() fails (FunctionSourceStash still absent -- nothing scoped yet), the job never re-runs, never re-derives the now-Indexed home, ScopeCode is never pulled -> deadlock RELOCATED (surfaces as DriveOutcome::Unresolved after indexing), not closed. The new test missed it because it calls demand_function_scope as a pure fn and never drives the blocked PublishFunctionSource job to wake.

FIX (both halves required together): keep the demand_function_scope classification change AND make jobs/source.rs append FunctionSourceStash ONLY when demand_function_scope returns empty. This aligns the code with fz-go4.38's DOCUMENTED intent (the comment already says 'append when empty'; the code appended always). Then each wait set is single-producer-coherent: pending -> {CodeIndexed} (wakes on index, re-runs, re-derives home, waits CodeScoped); found-home -> {CodeScoped} (co-produces FunctionSourceStash atomically in ScopeCode -- VERIFIED source_publish.rs:679 flows through ScopePublication::Complete.outputs into scope_code's single JobEffects with CodeScoped, so the CodeScoped-triggered re-run finds the stash present); empty -> {FunctionSourceStash} (first-arrival/dangling fallback, the ONLY legit arm-less wait). TEST must drive PublishFunctionSource end-to-end and assert it wakes+produces FunctionSource, not just snapshot demand_function_scope.

Minimalism lane: CLEAN -- fan-out provably necessary (no home index), prelude-index not new work (scope_code unconditionally waits CodeScoped(prelude)). Nits to fold: discoverability comment on the Scoped=>{} no-op arm.

title: demand_function_scope global branch dead-ends PublishFunctionSource on the arm-less FunctionSourceStash when a candidate home code is still Pending
